title: ProjectJannahHierarchicalMemoryNode
description: Represents a point or document indexed inside Qdrant vector store representing a piece of cognitive personal memory.

id.description: Unique identifier for the memory chunk.

userId.description: User identifier for multi-user context boundary.

domain.description: The specific life domain this memory node corresponds to.

content.description: The raw contextual fact, habit log, statement, or observation.

weight.description: Importance weight multiplier used for priority context engineering.

decayRate.description: How the memory weight reduces over days of inactivity.
